sections.A: Rotator cuff chaar muscles ka group hai jin ke tendons kandhe ke jor ko gher kar rakhte hain. Kandhe ka dard jo in se juda ho usay rotator cuff-related shoulder pain kehte hain.
sections.B: Dheere dheere baazu ke bahar ya upar dard, khaas kar haath upar karne, peeche le jaane aur raat ko usi taraf letne par. Baazu uthate waqt beech mein dard (painful arc).
sections.C: Dard kahan hai aur kohni se neeche jata hai ya nahi (gardan ka ishara), kaun se kaam barhate hain, aur kya chot lagi thi.
sections.D: Posture aur muscles ka sukhna dekhein, gardan screen karein, phir active aur passive range aur muscles ki taaqat check karein.
sections.E: Koi test perfect nahi. Dard wale tests batate hain ke cuff ka ilaqa irritable hai, lekin yeh nahi batate ke kaun sa tendon kharab hai.
sections.F: Frozen shoulder (passive range bohat kam), kandhe ki arthritis, gardan se aata dard aur AC joint ka dard isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Left kandhe ke dard ke saath seene ka dard ya paseena (dil), ya chot ke baad baazu na hil sakna: foran refer.
sections.H: Red flags, phir gardan, phir passive range ka bara nuqsan (frozen shoulder). Kuch na ho aur painful arc aur resisted dard ho to RCRSP.
sections.I: Thoracic aur kandhe ki mobilisation se thori der ka aaraam milta hai. Asal ilaaj exercise hai.
sections.J: Tendon ko itna load dein jitna patient bardasht kar sake, phir dheere dheere barhayein. Exercise mein halka dard jo agle din theek ho jaye chalega.
sections.K: Garmi ya barf aur TENS optional. Ultrasound recommend nahi.
sections.L: Samjhayein ke yeh aksar load wali exercise se theek hota hai aur scan ki findings se ghabrayein nahi. Phir 12 hafte tak dheere dheere load barhayein.
sections.M: Dard, painful arc, range, taaqat aur SPADI jaisa questionnaire dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 52 saal ke electrician ko haath upar karne par kandhe mein dard hai aur passive range poori hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education aur dheere dheere barhti exercise.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
